architecture.question: For PDP-11/70 virtual physical architecture, distinguish 16-bit virtual addresses from 22-bit physical addresses in at most 45 words. Cite the supplied reference.
architecture.answer: The PDP-11/70 uses 16-bit virtual addresses for programs, providing 64 KiB per address space. The memory-management unit translates these into 22-bit physical addresses spanning 4 MiB of space, which includes reserved device space [ref:1170-addresses].
